title: Can You Book a Private Boat in Madeira for Just Two People?
description: Yes. A private boat in Madeira is priced per boat, so two people pay the same 400 to 600 EUR as five, with the whole boat and the skipper to themselves.
heroAlt: Two people seen from behind at the stern of a small boat, with Funchal's hillside behind
keywords: can you book a private boat in Madeira for two people
private boat trip for two Madeira
private boat for a couple Madeira price
boat trip for two people Funchal
per boat price boat trip Madeira
